summary: The frozen candidate fixes the E1402 failure-retention defect for current-route known and unknown failures, commits aliases only after successful registration, and passes focused plus full controller tests. However, its same-route-epoch guard misses a reachable case: while registration is pending, navigate away, navigate back to /register, edit a newer draft, then resolve a known failure. The candidate clears all three newer rendered identity fields. Amend with this exact reproducer before acceptance; do not alter the passing alias/success behavior.

success_while_edited.projected_identity: submitted/committed identity rather than newer unsaved edits

profile_authority.foreign_runtime_profile: demo-jordan remained present/runtime after pending registration failure
profile_authority.captured_readonly_profile: reference-sarah remained present/captured-readonly after pending registration failure

evidence.credentials: All adversarial credentials were generated with randomUUID() and asserted absent from controller state, runtime.inspect(), actual PxC Part values, and fixture storage; no credential values appeared in stdout.

runner_history.initial_attempt: The first run of run-controller-checks.sh exited 1 because the script had not changed into its declared checkpoint working directory; both TAP outputs said the test file could not be found. This harness failure is preserved in first-attempt.log. The initial script bytes were not retained; the runner was then amended to cd to checkpoint and both checks passed.
runner_history.successful_capture: The fixed runner redirects Node's original stdout/stderr to focused.tap and controller.tap and records each process exit in focused.exit and controller.exit. The adversarial runner likewise stores original stdout/stderr in adversarial.raw.log and exit in adversarial.exit.
